title: APSO Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the .apsorc file used by APSO to define entities and relationships.

rootFolder.description: The root folder for generated source code.

from.description: The source entity name for the relationship.

to.description: The target entity name for the relationship.

nullable.description: Indicates if the relationship is nullable.

to_name.description: Custom name for the target side of the relationship (often for ManyToMany).

bi_directional.description: Indicates if the relationship is bidirectional (primarily for ManyToMany).

cascadeDelete.description: Indicates if deleting the 'from' entity should cascade delete related 'to' entities.

primary.description: (Optional) The foreign key column of this ManyToOne is the entity's primary key, or part of it: a table keyed by the row it extends. No 'id' column is generated. TypeScript services only.

foreignKeyName.description: (Optional) Name of the foreign key constraint on a ManyToOne or OneToMany. Defaults to the name TypeORM derives. 'apso import' sets it. TypeScript services only.

onDelete.description: (Optional) The foreign key's ON DELETE rule on a ManyToOne or OneToMany. 'cascadeDelete': true is the same as 'CASCADE'. 'SET NULL' needs 'nullable': true. Defaults to 'NO ACTION'.

joinTableName.description: (Optional) Custom name for the join table created for a ManyToMany relationship.

joinColumnName.description: (Optional) ManyToMany: custom name for the join table column that references the 'from' entity (owning side). ManyToOne, OneToMany and OneToOne: the name of the foreign key column itself, e.g. 'patient_id'; the generated property stays camelCase ('patientId'). 'apso import' sets it so an existing database keeps its column names. TypeScript services only for foreign keys.

inverseJoinColumnName.description: (Optional) Custom name for the foreign key column in the join table referencing the 'to' entity (inverse side) in a ManyToMany relationship.

index.description: (Optional) Index the foreign key column of a ManyToOne or OneToMany.

validate.description: (Optional) false keeps the foreign key NOT VALID: enforced for new rows, never checked against the rows already there. Migrations create it that way; a database built by TypeORM's schema sync has it validated. TypeScript services only.

entities.description: Defines the entities in the domain model.

apiType.description: The API style to generate. Case is ignored; defaults to 'rest'.

language.description: The language of the generated service. 'apso generate' needs it to run without a prompt.

auth.description: Sign-in and tenant configuration: a provider block, or a list of them. See the CLI's access rules for the fields of each provider.

emitEvents.description: Default for domain events: when true, every entity emits them unless it sets 'emitEvents': false.

http.description: Default for HTTP controllers: when false, no entity gets one unless it sets 'http': true.

coAuthor.description: Set false to skip the commit hook that adds the Apso co-author trailer.

query.description: How list routes read a request, for an app whose clients already exist. TypeScript only.

dialects.description: Query syntaxes the list routes accept. Defaults to ["postgrest"].

limit.description: Rows a list returns when the request names no limit. Defaults to 25.

alwaysPaginate.description: Answer every list with a page object instead of an array. Defaults to false.

guards.description: Set false to leave the generated guards out of the module list, for an app that registers its own. Not allowed with 'auth'.

created_at.description: Indicates if the entity should have a 'created_at' timestamp field.

updated_at.description: Indicates if the entity should have an 'updated_at' timestamp field.

timestampType.description: Column type of created_at and updated_at: one value for both, or one per column as { "created_at": ..., "updated_at": ... }. Defaults to 'timestamp' (no time zone). 'apso import' writes what the source columns use.

timestampNullable.description: Whether created_at and updated_at accept NULL: one boolean for both, or one per column as { "created_at": ..., "updated_at": ... }. Defaults to false (NOT NULL). 'apso import' writes what the source columns use.

timestampDefault.description: Whether created_at and updated_at have DEFAULT now(): one boolean for both, or one per column as { "created_at": ..., "updated_at": ... }. Defaults to true. Migrations honor false; TypeORM's own schema sync always writes the default. 'apso import' sets false when a source column has none.

primaryKeyName.description: Name of the primary key constraint. Defaults to the name TypeORM derives. 'apso import' sets it so an existing database keeps its constraint names. TypeScript services only.

primaryKeyType.description: The type of the generated 'id' primary key: 'serial' (auto-increment integer, the default), 'uuid' or 'text'. Ignored when a field or a relationship is the primary key.

uniques.description: Defines unique constraints spanning multiple fields.

name.description: The name of the unique constraint.

fields.description: The fields included in the unique constraint.
The fields belonging to the entity.

scopeBy.description: Field or path that holds the tenant of a row, or a list of them, for example 'workspaceId' or 'task.workspaceId'.

scopeOptions.description: Optional configuration for how scope enforcement should behave for this entity.

bypassRoles.description: Roles allowed to bypass scope enforcement (e.g., system_admin).

table.description: Explicit database table name. Defaults to the snake_cased entity name.

indexes.description: Indexes over one or more fields. A foreign key may be named by its relationship, its id property or its column.

name.description: The index's name. Defaults to the name TypeORM derives. 'apso import' sets it so an existing database keeps its index names.

where.description: A partial index: the SQL condition after WHERE, written against column names, for example 'deleted_at IS NULL'. Postgres only.

permissions.description: Roles allowed to perform each operation. A missing operation lets any signed-in caller do it; an empty list lets nobody.

mcp.description: Expose the entity's operations as MCP tools: true for all, or a list of operations.

emitEvents.description: Emit domain events for this entity, overriding the top-level default.

http.description: Generate an HTTP controller for this entity, overriding the top-level default.

checks.description: CHECK constraints: rules every row must satisfy, whatever writes it. 'apso import' carries the ones an existing database has.

name.description: The constraint's name. Defaults to the name TypeORM derives.

expression.description: The SQL condition, written against column names, for example 'end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date'.

validate.description: False keeps the constraint NOT VALID in migrations: new and changed rows are checked, rows already there are not. 'apso import' sets it for a constraint that is NOT VALID in the source.

foreignKeys.description: Foreign keys beyond the ones relationships make, for a column that has more than one. Each is a database constraint only, with no relation property. 'apso import' writes one when a column has a second foreign key. TypeScript only.

column.description: The column's database name, for example 'patient_id'.

to.description: The entity the key references, by its primary key.

onDelete.description: What happens to these rows when the referenced row is deleted. Defaults to NO ACTION.

validate.description: False keeps the key NOT VALID in migrations: new and changed rows are checked, rows already there are not.

primaryKeyDefault.description: SQL expression that fills a uuid 'id', for example 'gen_random_uuid()'. Defaults to uuid_generate_v4() from the uuid-ossp extension.

sqlIndexes.description: Indexes whose column list is SQL: an expression such as lower(email), or a column sorted DESC. Apso creates them in migrations and after a schema sync; TypeORM is told to leave them alone. TypeScript and Go services.

columns.description: The column list as SQL, for example 'user_id, created_at DESC' or 'lower(btrim(mrn))'.

where.description: The condition of a partial index.

type.description: The data type of the field. Note: PostGIS data types (geometry, geography, point, linestring, polygon, multipoint, multilinestring, multipolygon, geometrycollection) require the PostGIS extension to be installed in PostgreSQL.

unique.description: Indicates if the field must have a unique value.

nullable.description: Indicates if the field can be null.

length.description: Specifies the maximum length for string types.

is_email.description: Indicates if the field should be validated as an email address.

default.description: The default value for the field: a literal, or { "sql": "<expression>" } for a SQL expression such as now() or gen_random_uuid(). A json, jsonb or array field also takes an object or array literal.

values.description: The allowed values for an enum field.

precision.description: The total number of digits for decimal/numeric types.

scale.description: The number of digits after the decimal point for decimal/numeric types.

primary.description: The field is the primary key, or part of it. No 'id' column is generated.

elementType.description: Element type of an 'array' field, for example 'uuid' or 'integer'. Defaults to 'text'.

noDefault.description: The column has no database default. A boolean field otherwise defaults to false.

generated.description: The SQL expression of a stored generated column, e.g. "(quantity * price)". Postgres computes the value, so create and update requests do not accept the field. It cannot have a default. TypeScript only.
